summary: ITER44 CHAOS / FAULT-INJECTION audit of PadelAppRetas (pre App Store / Play Store). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter44_chaos_destructive.py with 59 destructive cases across 9 attack surfaces (login SQLi/XSS/huge/emoji, OTP request fault injection, OTP verify brute-force, public search with invalid coords / null bytes / emojis / SQLi / huge limits, admin reta create with negative/null/huge fields, public inscribirme with garbage UUIDs + 20 concurrent inscriptions for anti-oversell, MP OAuth forged state / no token / expired token, openapi.json regression, OTP spam x30 and OTP verify brute-force x40). FINAL: 58/59 PASS. ONE REAL BUG found: GET /api/public/retas/buscar?q=<NUL>... returns 500 because the user-controlled `q` is passed verbatim into a Mongo regex and Mongo rejects regex strings with embedded NUL (`Regular expression cannot contain an embedded null byte`). Rate-limit, anti-oversell, OAuth state HMAC, OTP brute-force lockout, OpenAPI generation (NOW 200 — iter43 issue fixed), MP callback forgery rejection, and global error sanitizer (reporte_id without leaking stack trace) ALL VERIFIED working. Frontend chaos: 45 brutal navigations (login↔admin/login↔home x15) with NO crash, NO pageerror, NO memory leak warning, no error overlay; 50 000-char paste into phone input accepted by component but no client-side max length (no crash, but a UX/abuse vector — server-side validation still catches it); 10 rapid-fire taps on 'ENVIARME CÓDIGO' do not crash but no visible debounce/spinner gating; emoji paste OK. Sentry: SDK imported and sentry_sdk.init() called when SENTRY_DSN present (which it is in backend/.env), but the `[sentry] inicializado` INFO log line is NOT showing up on current restart (likely because logging.basicConfig is configured AFTER the init block at server.py:39-63 so the INFO line is dropped) — Sentry capture is still active, only the start-up log message is missing. Backend global error handler returns reporte_id without leaking stack traces (verified in 500 response body for null-byte crash). All public endpoints sampled — only 1 crash discovered out of ~600+ destructive requests. Anti-oversell verified: 20 parallel inscriptions to the first active reta returned mixed 4xx/2xx with ZERO 500s.

critical.issue: 🟠 P1 — 500 Internal Server Error when query contains an embedded NUL byte. Repro: `curl 'https://.../api/public/retas/buscar?q=test%00admin'`. Root cause: routers/public.py:54-60 does `re.escape(q_norm)` then sends to Mongo as `{'$regex': safe}`; re.escape does NOT escape NUL because NUL is not a regex metachar, but PyMongo / Mongo rejects regexes with embedded NUL (`pymongo.errors.OperationFailure: Regular expression cannot contain an embedded null byte`). Trace ends at routers/public.py:64 `async for r in cursor`. Fix: sanitize early — `q_norm = q.strip().lower().replace('\x00', '')` (and arguably strip ALL ASCII control chars 0x00-0x1F except whitespace). Also consider capping `q` length (currently we accepted 10 000-char emoji query without issue but a 50 000-char payload could starve regex evaluator). Global error handler did its job (returned 500 with reporte_id, no stack trace leaked to client), but Sentry will see this on every crawler/bot scan and burn quota.

minor.issue: `[sentry] inicializado` INFO line at server.py:61-63 is NOT visible in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log on current restart. Likely because `logging.basicConfig` is configured AFTER the sentry init block — at module import time the root logger is still at WARNING. Sentry capture itself still works (DSN is read and sentry_sdk.init runs), only the visibility log is lost. Move the INFO log AFTER `logging.basicConfig(...)` or use `logging.getLogger('padelappretas-os').setLevel(logging.INFO)` before logging. LOW priority — observability only.

`?limit=99999`, `?page=-10`, and a 10 000-char `q` parameter all return 200 silently — no 422 validation. Backend has its own hard cap of 500 results (`.limit(500)`) so it does not actually return 99 999, but the API contract is unclear. RECOMMEND adding Pydantic Query() with `ge=1, le=100` on `limit` and `ge=1` on `page` so the API self-documents the bounds and returns 422 for abusers.

After 7 malformed logins from the same IP, the limiter returned 429 with retry_after=60. CORRECT behaviour, but the message `Demasiados intentos. Por favor espera unos minutos…` is fine for end-users but the legitimate admin tester is locked out too. Consider exempting requests from authenticated admin tokens or whitelisting CI test IPs. Not a bug — design tradeoff.

ui_bugs.issue: 🟡 P2 — Phone TextInput accepts 50 000 characters without client-side maxLength. No crash and the server still validates, but huge paste freezes the input render briefly (50k chars in a single line). Add `maxLength={20}` (international E.164 max is 15 + '+').

🔵 P3 — 10 rapid taps in <1 s do not crash the app, but there is no visible debounce / disabled-while-loading state on the button. The server-side rate limiter catches the spam (verified — 429 after a few requests) so it is not a security issue, but the UX is misleading (taps appear to do nothing). Recommend `disabled={isSending}` and a spinner during the request.

react_native_issues.issue: STILL installed at 8.13.0 but Expo SDK expects ~7.2.0 (Expo CLI logs `The following packages should be updated for best compatibility … @sentry/react-native@8.13.0 - expected version: ~7.2.0`). Same as iter43. Reference: /app/frontend/package.json. Either pin to ~7.2.0 OR confirm 8.x in a native build before App Store submission.

Bundler warning on every build: `Missing config for organization, project. Environment variables will be used as a fallback during the build.` Need to add `extra.sentry.organization` and `extra.sentry.project` to app.json or set EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_ORG / EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_PROJECT — otherwise source-map upload at build time will silently fail and crash reports in production will have minified stack traces with no symbolication.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE of the only P1 bug: GET /api/public/retas/buscar takes a `q` query param, runs `q.strip().lower()` then `re.escape(q_norm)` and passes the result to Mongo as a `$regex`. `re.escape` only escapes characters that are regex metacharacters (.+*?()[]{}|^$\); the NUL byte (0x00) is NOT a metacharacter so it passes through. PyMongo serializes the regex into BSON and Mongo's server-side regex engine refuses any regex pattern containing 0x00, raising `OperationFailure: Regular expression cannot contain an embedded null byte` (BadValue code 2). The exception bubbles up through motor's `async for`, hits the global error handler, returns 500 with reporte_id, and Sentry captures it. REPRO: `curl -i 'https://padel-tournament-hub-9.preview.emergentagent.com/api/public/retas/buscar?q=test%00admin'` → HTTP 500 with reporte_id. MITIGATION (one-line fix): in routers/public.py:48, replace `q_norm = q.strip().lower()` with `q_norm = ''.join(c for c in q.strip().lower() if c == ' ' or ord(c) >= 0x20) or None`. This strips ALL ASCII control characters (including NUL, tab, CR, LF, BEL, …) while preserving emojis and normal Unicode. Add the regression test from iter44 — it already covers null_byte, emoji, xss_in_query, sql_in_query, and massive_query.
